blocks.rationale: Agreement is distinct from an acceptable condition; the dialogue and state examples cannot naturally switch readings.
Non-stop travel is distinct from guiding a film production; the adverb and verb examples separate the uses.
The verb describes swapping items, while the noun describes an act of reciprocal exchange; the examples and labels separate them.
Structural soundness is distinct from honesty and moral principles; both examples make their domain clear.
Giving a person permission is distinct from allowing an event without stopping it; the coach and open-gate examples separate them.
Igniting, low weight, and pale color have distinct parts of speech, labels, definitions, and Vietnamese equivalents.
A short span of time is distinct from a particular point in time; the examples reinforce duration versus instant.
A proportion is distinct from the post-numeral rate modifier; the labels explain their related but different grammatical roles.
A reduction in pain is distinct from emergency aid; the meanings and examples remain separate in Vietnamese.
Turning around a point is distinct from taking turns in sequence; the examples distinguish movement from assigned turns.
A scheduled work period is distinct from a change in arrangement or opinion; labels and examples separate them.
Complete in every part is distinct from the combined amount; examples distinguish degree from arithmetic total.

editorialIssues.reason: Narrowed the Vietnamese equivalent to the skilled-occupation sense.
Realigned the target with the pinned slow-movement meaning; the hands-and-knees sense belongs to another use.
Broadened the Vietnamese equivalent to include children and young people.
Selected the sentential hope use and aligned its labels, definition, and translations.
Replaced the awkward imperative with a natural direct-travel example.
Used plural textiles for cloth materials made from recycled fibers.
Changed attributive far to a natural predicate adjective construction.
Expanded the Vietnamese equivalent beyond college students to first-year school or college students.
Rephrased the example around charging a fair price, giving it a natural Vietnamese translation.
Made the example establish that the item is the only surviving copy.
Kept the pinned severe-and-intense target and removed the conflicting acute-medical framing.
Narrowed the persuasive-or-engaging wording to the pinned attention-holding meaning.
Replaced the awkward steep-rock collocation with bare rock across a landscape.
Named deaths and injuries explicitly in the label and example translation.
Used a natural scrape-paint-off construction with a clear Vietnamese equivalent.
Removed the separate cause meaning and replaced the redundant Vietnamese equivalent.
Replaced a borrowing-like tool swap with an unambiguous exchange for something else.
Removed the repeated word for set from the Vietnamese example translation.
Changed repayment to regular monthly instalments and translated the payment schedule naturally.
Limited leadership to the act of guiding a group toward a shared goal.
Replaced the unclear missed-connections example with a natural cause-and-result example.
Clarified that the firework fuse burns through before the firework explodes.
Replaced the ambiguous delivery-cost example with a direct price comparison.
Translated calm nature as a person's disposition rather than an abstract essence.
